entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return a jersey. Order number is VF78-991-04B.

Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me just pull up that order... VF78-991-04B. Got it. To make sure I understand, is there a technical fault with the item, or is it more of a preference issue?
It's the wrong size. The jersey is just too tight. I want to return it or get an exchange. Is that possible, yes or no?
Yes, absolutely. I see the order was delivered 27 days ago, and our standard items, like this jersey, have a 90-day return window. You're well within that timeframe.

I've just approved the return in our system. I can email you a prepaid shipping label right now. Would you prefer a full refund back to your original payment method, or would you like to exchange it for a different size?
Just send the label for a refund. I'll handle reordering.

Understood. I'm sending that email now. Also, I see here that you're one of our VIP members. To thank you for your loyalty and for the sizing inconvenience, I've added a complimentary $20 credit to your account for your next order.
Oh. Okay, fine. Thanks. Just make sure that email comes through.
It's on its way to your inbox as we speak. Once we receive the returned jersey, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
